summary.headline: Astrological Elections, Chapters 50–71
summary.text: Continuation of an astrological chapter list, entries 50–71, covering lunar sign elections for garments, wells, travel, commerce, bloodletting, marriage, childbirth, weaning, bathing, letters, remedies, omens, hopes, fortune, the ascendant, timing outcomes, surety, and identifying a person encountered. References include the Indians and Florentine codex 12, folio 82v.
